scope: exploratory candidate-only ICAE protocol pilot; excluded from the frozen statistical study

invalidation.message: The external-action receipt hashed the complete Bash argument object. Harness-required description and scheduler metadata changed that object without changing the docker-exec side effect, so the guard rejected the intended command and the model entered a recovery loop.
invalidation.secondaryObservedFailure: A later Bash call used host workdir /workspace, which does not exist on the host; this produced spawn bash ENOENT and is not evidence that the Bash executor itself is unavailable.

conclusions.nextAction: Bind external-action identity through an adapter-specific semantic normalization while retaining full raw arguments for snapshot and final verification; make refresh, Bash, and checkpoint explicitly serial; rerun candidate-only before any fresh paired comparison.
